001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.spi;
002
003import java.util.Map;
004
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.ScopedKeyValues;
006
007/**
008 * Service Provider Interface for
009 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.ScopedKeyValues}, discovered with
010 * {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}. At most one provider is expected to be on the
011 * classpath/module path at a time - the first one found is used.
012 * <p>
013 * A provider owns the actual storage mechanism (a real implementation backs it with
014 * {@code java.lang.ScopedValue}); this module never references that type directly so it
015 * can stay dependency-free and compile on older JDKs. When no provider is found,
016 * {@code ScopedKeyValues} falls back to one that runs the body without recording
017 * anything, the same "safe with nothing bound" behavior SLF4J's own facade falls back to
018 * when no {@code org.slf4j.spi.SLF4JServiceProvider} is found.
019 */
020public interface ScopedKeyValuesProvider {
021
022        /**
023         * Creates a fresh {@link ScopedKeyValues.Builder} for one layer of key values. Owned
024         * by this provider so an addition can be written directly into its own internal
025         * representation, rather than every push forcing a copy through an intermediate
026         * {@link Map}.
027         * @return builder.
028         */
029        ScopedKeyValues.Builder builder();
030
031        /**
032         * Every currently pushed layer, merged into one map - later (more deeply nested)
033         * pushes win on a key collision.
034         * @return merged, read-only-by-convention map, empty if nothing is currently pushed.
035         */
036        Map<String, String> currentMerged();
037
038}
